dialogues.speaker: Sanguinetti
dialogues.text: You can try some Fontainian Foie Gras alongside this red wine blend of Sassica and Ornella, produced on Erinnyes.

dialogues.speaker: Sanguinetti
dialogues.text: This wine is naturally sweet and carries a slightly sour note, while its fruity flavors stand out to balance out the fatty flavor, rounding it out and making it even more elegant.

dialogues.speaker: Sanguinetti
dialogues.text: Finally, allow its silky finish to fill your senses with the fragrance of roasted Figs and Sweet Flowers as a parting gift.

dialogues.speaker: Sanguinetti
dialogues.text: Those revelers who raise their champagnes in toast can never appreciate such beauty.
